project.name: Guitar Polyphony Lab
project.program_context: Independent guitar-polyphony verification, physical-feasibility research, differential Engine verification, future feasibility oracle, and future learned guitar evidence research

primary_project_purpose.summary: Build an independent evidence-first laboratory that verifies guitar-polyphony semantics and physical feasibility without becoming the production TAB authority.
questions_the_lab_should_answer: What polyphonic musical facts does the source MusicXML actually contain?
Which notes are active simultaneously and how are voice/staff/tie facts represented?
Which string/fret positions are physically possible for a declared six-string tuning and capo configuration?
Which simultaneous-note sets have valid distinct-string assignments?
Does musicxml-to-guitar-tab-engine agree with the independent Lab reference semantics for the same source fixture?
When production reports or behaves as if a passage is infeasible, is it truly physically impossible or did the production search fail to find a solution?
In later research only, among physically valid realizations, which solutions are more plausible or ergonomic according to measured evidence?
not_the_project_purpose: Do not turn the Lab into the production MusicXML-to-TAB engine.
Do not make the production Engine depend on this repository at runtime.
Do not make the Lab the Canonical TAB writer, renderer, playback engine, OMR system, or UI.
Do not replace deterministic physical validity with a learned model.
Do not silently mutate source musical facts to obtain a guitar solution.

authority_model.lab_authority: independent reference semantics, bounded physical-feasibility research, deterministic evidence and benchmark reports
authority_model.evidence_direction: Lab evidence -> reviewed production change -> production CI
authority_model.forbidden_direction: production runtime import of Lab modules
authority_model.hard_rule: hard deterministic physical constraints have higher authority than learned ranking or probabilistic evidence

next_stage_execution_plan.title: Fresh-read exact current branch and PR state
actions: Re-read README.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/REPOSITORY_REALITY.md, docs/V1B-SEMANTIC-COMPARATOR.md, src/verification/semanticComparator.js and its tests.

actions: Start with existing committed and provenance-approved compatibility fixtures already present in the Lab registry.

next_stage_execution_plan.title: Generate real Engine PolyphonicSourceModel artifacts
actions: Use the production repository's actual reviewed parser/projector path that produces PolyphonicSourceModel 1.0.0.

next_stage_execution_plan.title: Define and validate artifact provenance envelope
actions: Add a small versioned Lab-owned artifact metadata/envelope contract if one does not already exist.
Require fixture ID/hash, Engine repository, Engine commit SHA, Engine contract version, generation metadata that affects semantics, and artifact hash.
Reject missing, unknown, malformed, or version-incompatible evidence fail-closed.
Do not trust filenames as provenance.
next_stage_execution_plan.acceptance: CI can prove which source fixture and Engine revision produced each compared artifact.

next_stage_execution_plan.title: Wire pinned artifacts into deterministic Lab tests
actions: Build the Lab semantic snapshot from the exact fixture.
Adapt the pinned Engine artifact through the existing V1B adapter.
Run compareSemanticSnapshots().
Assert deterministic equality for known-equal fixtures or pin explicit reviewed mismatch evidence when a real semantic difference is discovered.
Do not alter the comparator simply to force green equality.
next_stage_execution_plan.acceptance: At least the initial approved 2-voice and 4-voice compatibility fixtures execute end-to-end Lab-vs-Engine comparison in automated tests.

next_stage_execution_plan.title: Add mismatch evidence discipline
actions: If a mismatch is found, classify whether it is fixture/provenance error, Lab reference bug, Engine semantic difference, unsupported contract surface, or genuine production defect.
Add the smallest reproducible fixture/evidence needed.
Do not mutate production behavior from this repository.
Production fixes require a separate Engine PR with its own tests.
next_stage_execution_plan.acceptance: Every mismatch has deterministic classification and reproducible evidence.

next_stage_execution_plan.title: Close V1B documentation and CI gate
actions: Update README.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/REPOSITORY_REALITY.md, docs/V1B-SEMANTIC-COMPARATOR.md and docs/DOCUMENTATION_AUDIT.md to repository reality.
Run locked dependency install, npm run check and npm test.
Confirm exact-head PR-triggered CI is green.
Confirm no runtime dependency on musicxml-to-guitar-tab-engine was introduced.
next_stage_execution_plan.acceptance: V1B may be marked complete only when real pinned Engine artifact comparisons run in Lab CI.

sequence.goal: expand licensed external polyphony compatibility corpus with provenance and regression coverage
failure intelligence: mismatch classes, unplayable reasons, regressions and reproducible failure fixtures
independent offline/CI feasibility oracle such as CP-SAT to separate true impossibility from production search failure
guitar-specific research including ergonomics, N-best solutions, FretNet-style audio evidence and learned ranking

authoritative_external_reference.paper: FretNet: Continuous-Valued Pitch Contour Streaming for Polyphonic Guitar Tablature Transcription
authoritative_external_reference.observed_role: audio-driven string-aware tablature, continuous relative-pitch and onset research

secondary_same_name_repository.observed_characteristics: 2026 CRNN/CQT per-string 21-class inference with a committed checkpoint
secondary_same_name_repository.restriction: No repository license was observed during review; do not copy or vendor code/data without a separate licensing/provenance review.

fretnet_research_direction.future_architectural_role: shadow evidence/ranking layer over deterministic P2A/P2B-valid candidates only
allowed_future_outputs: benchmark rankings among already-valid deterministic candidates
forbidden_authority: making probabilistic evidence a hard physical fact
required_before_any_ranking_change: separate reviewed approval gate for any ranking-policy influence

non_negotiable_invariants: Source MusicXML is immutable evidence; do not rewrite source facts to make a solution easier.
Unsupported or ambiguous semantics fail closed or remain explicitly unknown.
Production Engine remains the production authority.
No production runtime dependency from musicxml-to-guitar-tab-engine to Guitar Polyphony Lab.
Lab code may consume production-generated data artifacts, but must not import production runtime modules to create a hidden coupled oracle.
P2A deterministic physical candidate validity cannot be overridden by ML/probabilistic ranking.
Technique provenance remains metadata-only until an explicit physical-semantics research gate is reviewed and approved.
External fixtures/models/data require explicit provenance and licensing review before repository inclusion.
Do not introduce automatic pitch correction as an implicit side effect of feasibility or ranking research.
Do not change production behavior merely to make Lab comparison green.

learned ranking affecting actual solver ordering rather than shadow evidence
new external datasets/models/code with unclear or incompatible licensing
destructive history rewrites or unrelated deletion of repository evidence
silent expansion of supported musical semantics by guessing

quality_requirements.documentation: After each completed implementation slice, update the architecture/reality docs so planned behavior is never described as implemented and implemented behavior is never described as future-only.

required: PR-triggered CI on exact head SHA is green
no unresolved review thread identifies a correctness/safety issue
merge_gate.behavior: If all required gates are green and repository policy permits autonomous merge for the approved stage, merge using the repository's normal method. If any gate is uncertain, leave the PR merge-ready and report the exact blocker instead of weakening the gate.

final_instruction_to_developer: Continue autonomously from the existing V1B branch and PR. First close the real Engine-artifact comparison loop; do not jump to FretNet, CP-SAT, or learned ranking while V1B remains artifact-incomplete. Preserve the Lab/production authority boundary, keep source evidence immutable, fail closed on unsupported contracts, update documentation after each slice, and leave reproducible evidence for every semantic difference discovered. Once V1B is genuinely closed by pinned Engine artifacts running in Lab CI, proceed in roadmap order unless a separately reviewed gate explicitly changes that order.
